label: Spotify Now Playing
description: A Spotify now-playing card with album art, track title, artist, an animated equalizer, and a progress bar that advances. Use to show the currently playing track as an overlay.

scale.label: Blow the fixed-size card up for hero shots (e.g. 1.6)

layout.label: Layout
layout.description: card = portrait hero layout: big square album art on top, track/artist below, Spotify badge at the bottom. Default is the compact horizontal now-playing bar.
